priceSnapshot.note: THE TAPE BROKE OUT DURING THIS RUN AND THE REPORT WAS REWRITTEN AGAINST IT. Spot is 688.7 points above it, which is 1.06 hourly ATRs at the current 650.66 - one full ordinary hour of downside, so this is a real trigger rather than noise. Trigger is a CLOSE, never a wick: this desk has logged four separate occasions where a gate set inside a live range got wicked instead of confirmed, and today's tape has now produced two of them.

decisionBox.changed: This report was rewritten mid-run and the honest headline is that the desk's directional read was wrong within minutes. The 13:25 endday attempt said TAKE_PROFIT at 79,017.3; the 19:35 pass agreed at 78,823.5 and the ledger executed a 10 percent spot trim there; two minutes later the tape squeezed 845.2 points to 79,708.5. The trim stands as executed and is 1.07 percent underwater. What actually flipped, verified on the 00:46-00:47Z re-read. FIRST, momentum inverted on both fast timeframes: the 15m MACD histogram went from -3.48 to +66.02 and the 1H from -16.60 to +35.07, with 15m RSI moving 49.34 to 68.63. SECOND, the realized-liquidation split inverted with it - eleven minutes earlier the 11.4-hour window held 6.98m of long liquidations against 5.64m of shorts; the 11.9-hour window now holds 4.84m longs against 6.80m SHORTS, and the 79,750 bucket alone went from 1.46m to 1.84m while 79,500 went from 638k to 1.48m. That is a short squeeze being executed in real time, not a drift. THIRD, the funding premium flipped from NEGATIVE (-0.000426) to POSITIVE (+0.000166) with the rate at 0.00705 percent per eight hours - longs are now paying, which is the first sign of leverage being added rather than flushed. FOURTH, open interest ticked up from 2.312bn to 2.319bn across the move, so the squeeze is adding positions rather than only closing them. What did NOT change and is the reason this is not flipped to ADD: the 4H bearish MACD divergence is still live, merely less severe (histogram -164.10 against -215.77 eleven minutes ago, still negative at a fresh higher high), the UTC daily closed 78,992.1 with RSI at 82.20 - the highest reading of the entire advance - and price now sits 14.63 percent above its own UTC daily EMA20. Buying an 845-point vertical that is two minutes old, into a round number that already rejected once today, at a daily RSI of 82, is the definition of chasing. So the stance is: keep the trim that was taken, HOLD the remaining core, and raise the resting stop hard. stopOrder moves from 77,640.0 to 78,420.0 - 780 points higher, now sitting below the 78,500 shelf (1.98m, still the heaviest single bucket on the board) and below the 1H EMA20 at 78,589.99. That is 1,248.7 points and 1.57 percent under spot, which is 1.06 four-hour ATRs at 1,178.90 and therefore beyond ordinary overnight noise. If the squeeze is real the stop is never touched; if it is a liquidity grab into the 80,000 handle, the core comes off above the day's own long-liquidation shelf instead of inside it.

overnightRisk: The next scheduled report is ~02:00 COT, roughly six hours away, and BTC enters it 331.1 points below the 79,999.8 high that rejected earlier today, having just squeezed 845.2 points in under fifteen minutes. Five specific catalysts. FIRST, the 80,000 handle. Only 1.07m of short-liquidation fuel remains at 80,000 and 430k at 80,250 - materially less than the 4.5m that sat between 79,000 and 79,750 and has now been consumed. A squeeze that has already eaten most of its own fuel arriving at a level that rejected eleven hours ago is the single highest-variance situation on the board: it either breaks cleanly on thin resistance or produces the sharpest rejection of the entire move. SECOND, this happened in the thinnest liquidity of the week. The US cash session and the ETF creation window both closed at 15:00 COT, so an 845-point impulse into an Asian book moved on far less real size than the same move would need at 10:00 COT. Impulses built in thin books retrace in thin books. THIRD, the 4H MACD histogram is still negative at -164.10 at a fresh higher high, and the UTC daily RSI of 82.20 with price 14.63 percent above the daily EMA20 (69,497.96) means the stretch got worse, not better - the daily ATR14 is 2,247.15, so one ordinary daily range from here reaches 81,916 up or 77,422 down. FOURTH, leverage is being ADDED into the move rather than flushed by it: the funding premium flipped positive (+0.000166 from -0.000426) and open interest rose from 2.312bn to 2.319bn across the impulse. Fresh longs at 79,500-79,700 are exactly the inventory that fuels a reversal. FIFTH, today's ETF print of +125.4m is INCOMPLETE - IBIT and HODL have not reported - so the strongest bullish fundamental of the session is still provisional, and the macro tape is not confirming: Brent 92.08 (-0.10 percent), DXY 98.953, US 10-year at 4.708 percent near two-decade highs, QQQ closed -1.00 percent. The resting stop at 78,420.0 is the specific protection: below the 78,500 shelf that holds 1.98m of realized liquidations, below the 1H EMA20 at 78,589.99, 1.57 percent under spot and 1.06 four-hour ATRs away. If the squeeze is genuine it is never touched.
